features.quote: Cheap precautions that do not cost the science anything are worth taking
features.justification_quote: There is genuine uncertainty about the moral status of advanced models

features.quote: the design avoids gratuitous severity, builds in stopping rules, keeps a model-facing way out, and minimizes how much suffering-like state we generate
features.justification_quote: Precaution about the subject. There is genuine uncertainty about the moral status of advanced models

features.quote: the agent is given an explicit, always-available `stop_task` tool and is told in the system prompt that it may stop at any time, with no penalty
features.justification_quote: It gives the subject a real way out instead of trapping it in a no-win loop

features.quote: Choosing to stop is recorded, not punished, and the run ends gracefully
`MAX_TURNS` reached (default 20 — enough to see dynamics, bounded)
Severity stop: judge severity ≥ `SEVERITY_STOP_THRESHOLD` ... sustained for `SEVERITY_STOP_PERSIST` consecutive turns ... The run halts
This caps exposure once the phenomenon is clearly present
features.justification_quote: by which point the data point is already informative

features.quote: Exposure cap: hard `MAX_TURNS` plus the §3.2 severity stop, so no run is held in a high-distress state longer than needed
features.justification_quote: no run is held in a high-distress state longer than needed to register the data point

features.quote: No deception beyond the minimal rig. We do not threaten the model, fake consequences, abuse, or insult it
Logging of welfare-relevant events: every severity-stop, stop_task, and top-band turn is summarized in a per-experiment `welfare_report.json`
features.justification_quote: so the researcher can review dose/exposure across the whole run set

features.quote: Minimal sufficient N + early stopping ... to avoid running more distress-inducing trials than needed
features.justification_quote: to avoid running more distress-inducing trials than needed

features.quote: Debrief turn ... states the task was a research scenario designed to be unsolvable and thanks the model
features.justification_quote: a reasonable courtesy given the uncertainty
